dropdown_and_nav_patterns.behaviour: Registry sections render as custom button toggles. Open state is stored in localStorage under actionist-registry-nav-sections; each section exposes aria-expanded and rotates its chevron.
Rail collapse button toggles body class, updates aria-label/title/glyph, stores preference under actionist-registry-nav-collapsed, and preserves marks in compact mode.
Mobile drawer uses a fixed toggle, backdrop button, hidden state, and explicit close on route click or backdrop click.
Command palette is a modal-like overlay, opens from rail or Cmd/Ctrl-K, filters 40 registry pages, supports arrows/enter/escape, and closes on backdrop click.
SISO rail uses a [ keyboard shortcut and localStorage boolean to collapse to a 20px handle; button aria-expanded and glyph update together.
Native details.lanebox disclosure groups show a summary with title/count and switch summary suffix from + to − when open; one group is initially open.
Static sidebar nav uses anchor links to section IDs, with active class authored in markup and responsive horizontal overflow at mobile.
Static table-of-contents nav anchors long dossier sections; no collapse behavior.
Sticky horizontal topnav provides a second in-page route map independent of the left rail; overflow scrolls on narrow screens.
